rework_resolutions.item_1_g1_request_examples: RESOLVED: Syntactically complete, parsed HTTP Request and Response wire examples added to all 4 specs.
rework_resolutions.item_2_x420_negotiation_protocol: RESOLVED: Formal ActionSelectionEnvelope schema, queue_id correlation, negotiation_endpoint, and verification mechanics for WAIT, PAY, DELEGATE, OUR_LADY, and FSCK_OFF.

rework_resolutions.item_5_g4_no_local_urls: RESOLVED: All file:/// links replaced with relative repo links.
rework_resolutions.item_6_test_suite_conformance: RESOLVED: Test suite verifies separate request/response HTTP wire blocks, validates all 7 Draft 2020-12 JSON schemas and validates all example payloads against schemas without external dependencies.
rework_resolutions.item_7_x410_retention_semantics: RESOLVED: Clarified perpetual cryptographic revocation vs edge fast-path SLA window retain_tombstone_days, post-retention archive redirection to public_audit_log_url, and client infinite TTL tombstone caching.
rework_resolutions.item_8_x420_interop_fallback: RESOLVED: Normative RFC 9110 status code clarification and formal HTTP 429/503 fallback profile with X-xHTTP-Profile header and application/xhttp+json content type.
